name: 3D Siddon's Method for Intercept Matrix Calculation
definition: A method to calculate the length of intersection between X-ray rays and voxels in a 3D grid, used to construct the intercept matrix A for CT reconstruction.
summary: 3D Siddon's Method calculates exact ray-voxel intersection lengths to construct the intercept matrix for Cone Beam Computed Tomography, distinguishing itself by explicitly computing this matrix unlike direct reconstruction algorithms.
